motivation: Use the retrospective nature of peer-review datasets to evaluate whether historical reviews pointed toward later mainstream or SOTA research trajectories.
core_hypothesis: Useful human scientific taste is the subset of review feedback that would have changed the research trajectory toward a later high-value frontier.

experimental_unit.paper_t: paper content available at original submission time
experimental_unit.reviews_t: peer reviews available at original review time
experimental_unit.frontier_t_plus_delta: later field trajectory or SOTA descriptors, typically 2 to 5 years after the paper

claim_boundary: Protocol only. Positive results would show reusable directional signal in historical reviews, not that reviewers literally predicted the future or that all human feedback improves automated science.
